provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Proper names use the paired game localization dictionary; original guide sources remain in its metadata.

lead.text: Avoid clearing the initial adds too quickly; let allied action slots grow before facing the reinforcements. Offset Evade with Defense Skills to stop repeated SP loss. Defeating Aida greatly reduces the remaining enemies' SP.

listLead.text: Prepare action slots and SP for reinforcements. Offset Evade with defense rather than letting weak attacks be repeatedly dodged.

statNote.text: A regular encounter in 2-18. All enemies are Lv. 13. Starts with 4 adds; reinforcements consist of 6 adds and Aida. Adds have 68 HP and Defense Level 13; Aida has 267 HP and Defense Level 11. Targeting is not freely assignable as it is in Focused Encounters.

skillNote.text: All 14 skills used by Aida and the 2 add types. Skills sharing a name are listed separately when their Coin counts or effects differ. The Attack Power Down value for ¿Eso es todo? is unspecified; do not assume it is 3 like Paralyze. The Stagger Threshold reduction from Pañata Party~!'s Heads hit applies to the user itself.

priorities.0.text: Raise 5 Sinners to around the recommended Lv. 13. Use the first 4 enemies to build action slots and SP rather than entering reinforcements before your main attackers have enough actions.

priorities.1.text: Avoid repeatedly attacking Evade with weak skills. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it and stop repeated SP loss.

priorities.2.text: Aida starts with 3 slots and can reach 5. Block necessary attacks while dealing Slash damage, then use the remaining enemies' 45 SP loss on her defeat to finish the fight.

troubleshooting.0.symptom.text: Reinforcements immediately overwhelm me with unopposed attacks

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: Defeating the initial enemies too quickly can bring reinforcements before allied slots have fully increased. If your core lacks actions, spend the opening taking winning Clashes before advancing.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Repeated Evades drain SP until I cannot win

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Successful Evades are reused and also reduce SP. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it. If attacking through it, use the prediction to choose a skill that can reliably beat it.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The enemy will not Stagger despite taking damage

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: Aida lowers her Stagger Threshold by 5 on a successful Evade. Pañata Party~! also lowers her own Threshold. Limit failed attacks against Evade and enemy unopposed attacks.

units.0.notes.0.text: Appears with reinforcements. Starts with 3 slots, up to 5. Defeating her in combat reduces all remaining enemies' SP by 45.

units.0.notes.1.text: Heals 10 SP for all enemies each turn. At 20 SP or higher, gains 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up at Turn Start.

units.1.notes.0.text: 2 initially; 3 in reinforcements. Starts with 1 slot, increasing to a maximum of 2.

units.1.notes.1.text: Uses ¡Olé! to Evade, reducing the attacker's SP by 5 on success. Danza de Paz strengthens all allies' Defense Skills.

units.2.notes.0.text: 2 initially; 3 in reinforcements. Starts with 1 slot, increasing to a maximum of 2.

units.2.notes.1.text: Has no Evade skill and increases its own Attack Power. Puñales Joviales becomes stronger against targets with low SP.

phases.0.steps.0.text: Starts with 2 Mariachi Alegre and 2 Mariachi Vivaz. Slash is effective against both. Take winning Clashes to raise allied SP.

phases.0.steps.1.text: In regular encounters, allied slots increase as turns pass. If reinforcements overwhelm your action count, avoid clearing the initial wave immediately; build more actions for your main attackers first.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Replace weak skills aimed at Evade with Defense Skills to Offset it. Check enemy Speed and automatically assigned targeting lines; do not assume the free retargeting available in Focused Encounters.

phases.1.title.text: Block dangerous attacks and deal Slash damage

phases.1.steps.0.text: Reinforcements include 6 adds and Aida. She starts with 3 slots and can increase to 5 if left alive. Check whether you have enough actions to handle the enemies' multiple attacks.

phases.1.steps.1.text: Aida's ¿Eso es todo? costs the target 10 SP if she wins the Clash and applies debuffs next turn on hit. Prioritize winning with strong skills or available E.G.O.

phases.1.steps.2.text: The enemies heal SP across their team every turn. Repeatedly attacking Evade while your own SP is low prolongs the disadvantage; recover through Offsetting and winning Clashes.

phases.2.title.text: Prevent Evade from lowering her Threshold and finish the fight

phases.2.steps.0.text: Aida has ×2 Slash and ×0.5 Blunt resistance. Use Slash to reach her Stagger Threshold rather than relying only on Blunt. Successful Evades lower the Threshold, so keep Offsetting them with Defense Skills.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Defeating her in combat activates Se Acabó la Fiesta, reducing all remaining enemies' SP by 45. Finish the survivors during this opening.

phases.2.steps.2.text: While adds remain, do not spend every action attacking Aida. Also prevent SP-draining Clash and On Hit effects.

skills.0.response.text: Each Coin heals the enemy's own SP by 2 on hit. Clash against adds as well, preventing enemies from gaining an increasing Heads advantage.

skills.1.effects.0.text: [On Use] Grant 1 Defense Power Up to all allies next turn.

skills.1.response.text: On Use, grants all allies 1 Defense Power Up next turn. Winning the Clash does not stop this effect, so watch for stronger Evades.

skills.2.effects.0.text: [On Evade] Reduce the target's SP by 5.

skills.2.response.text: A successful Evade reduces the attacker's SP by 5. Switch the action aimed at Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it, then use spare attacks against other enemies.

skills.3.effects.0.text: [Clash Win] Reduce the target's SP by 5.

skills.3.effects.1.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn.

skills.3.response.text: If the enemy wins the Clash, your Sinner loses 5 SP. Coin 3 also inflicts 2 Attack Power Down next turn on hit, so take a Clash you can win.

skills.4.response.text: Each Coin heals the enemy's own SP by 2 on hit. Clash against adds as well, preventing enemies from gaining an increasing Heads advantage.

skills.5.effects.0.text: [On Use] Gain 1 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.5.response.text: On Use, gains 1 Attack Power Up next turn. Winning the Clash does not remove On Use effects, so check the next prediction again.

skills.6.effects.0.text: [Clash Win] Reduce the target's SP by 5.

skills.6.effects.1.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Inflict 2 Attack Power Down next turn.

skills.6.response.text: If the enemy wins the Clash, your Sinner loses 5 SP. Coin 3 also inflicts 2 Attack Power Down next turn on hit, so take a Clash you can win.

skills.7.effects.0.text: Gain +1 Skill Power when attacking a target with SP below 0.

skills.7.response.text: Gains +1 Skill Power against targets below 0 SP. Taking all 4 Coins unopposed compounds damage, so restore allies with low SP.

skills.8.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.

skills.8.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.

skills.8.effects.3.text: Ⅲ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.

skills.8.effects.4.text: Ⅳ[On Hit] Gain 1 Poise next turn.

skills.8.response.text: Winning the Clash does not stop its On Use healing of 5 SP. Its 4 Coins gain Poise next turn on hit, so avoid letting the attack through unopposed.

skills.9.effects.0.text: [Clash Win] Deal 10 SP damage to the target.

skills.9.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict Attack Power Down and 3 Paralyze next turn.

skills.9.response.text: If the enemy wins the Clash, your Sinner loses 10 SP. On Hit also inflicts Attack Power Down and 3 Paralyze next turn, so match it with a winning skill or E.G.O.

skills.10.effects.0.text: [On Evade] Lower own Stagger Threshold by 5. Deal 5 SP damage to the target.

skills.10.response.text: A successful Evade lowers the enemy's own Stagger Threshold by 5 and reduces the attacker's SP by 5. Switch the slot targeting Evade to a Defense Skill to Offset it instead of letting weak attacks be repeatedly dodged.

skills.11.effects.0.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Attack Power Up next turn.

skills.11.response.text: Coin 2 gains 2 Attack Power Up next turn on hit. Use the current prediction to take a Clash and prevent SP and Power bonuses from compounding.

skills.12.effects.0.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Gain 2 Defense Power Up next turn.

skills.12.response.text: Coin 2 gains 2 Defense Power Up next turn on hit, strengthening the next Evade. Prevent the hit or retain an action for Offsetting it with defense.

skills.13.effects.0.text: [On Use] When attacking an enemy below 0 SP, increase critical hit chance based on the target's SP.

skills.13.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Heads Hit] Lower own Stagger Threshold by 50% of the damage dealt.

skills.13.response.text: Critical chance increases against targets below 0 SP according to their SP. A Heads hit on Coin 1 lowers the enemy's own Stagger Threshold, so avoid taking it unopposed with low SP.

passives.0.condition.text: Every turn / own SP at 20 or higher

passives.0.effect.text: Heal 10 SP for all allies, including self. At Turn Start, if own SP is at least 20, gain 1 Attack Power Up and 1 Defense Power Up.

passives.0.response.text: Enemies regain SP during longer fights. Check current Power and Evade predictions and use skills that can win.

passives.1.response.text: Defeating Aida weakens the remaining enemies. Aim to finish her while also preparing for unopposed attacks during the process.

mechanics.0.effect.text: Starts with 4 adds. Reinforcements bring 6 adds and Aida. Both sides gain actions as turns pass; Aida starts with 3 slots and can reach 5.

mechanics.0.response.text: If rushing the opening leaves you short of actions, prepare by taking Clashes against the initial enemies.

mechanics.1.effect.text: Successful Evades by Mariachi Alegre and Aida reduce the attacker's SP by 5. Aida also lowers her own Stagger Threshold by 5.

mechanics.1.response.text: Offset Evade with Defense Skills to stop weak attacks from being repeatedly dodged.

mechanics.2.effect.text: At Turn Start, Low Morale grants 2 Attack Power Down; Panic grants 4 Attack Power Down. Adds enter Low Morale at -20 SP or lower; Aida's threshold is unknown. Panic occurs at -45 SP.

mechanics.2.response.text: Lowering enemy SP can suppress their attacks, but they also heal each turn. Check their current state.

warnings.0.text: This is a regular encounter. Do not follow a plan that assumes freely assigned targets as in Focused Encounters.

warnings.1.text: Clearing the opening too quickly may bring reinforcements while allied action slots are still insufficient.

warnings.2.text: Aida is weak to Slash and resistant to Blunt. Keep those resistances distinct.

warnings.3.text: The Attack Power Down value of ¿Eso es todo? is unspecified. Do not fill it in as 3 just because Paralyze has that value.

preparation.0.text: Raise 5 core Sinners to around the recommended Lv. 13. Prepare levels that can win Clashes and a selection of Slash skills.

preparation.1.text: If E.G.O is available, save it to recover unfavorable Clashes. Offset Evade with defense instead of always trying to overpower it.

roles.0.reason.text: Exploit the adds' and Aida's Slash weakness to Stagger and defeat them.

roles.1.name.text: Defense Skills in slots targeting Evade

roles.1.reason.text: Prevent SP loss and lowered Stagger Thresholds from successful Evades.

roles.2.reason.text: Restore SP lost through Evades and failed Clashes to reduce the Heads chance gap between your team and the enemies.
